summary: Add deterministic ordered-membership paging boundary and compatibility coverage

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: No admission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds HTTP tests for root/folder tuple ties, host/projection/epoch reset errors, revoked and unknown credentials, legacy cursor shapes and expiry, maximal legal rows with authoritative counts, and WAL recycling while abandoned cursor strings remain alive. Adds an old-snapshot codec test for time-independent continuation. Current legal row and page caps do not reach byte-budget truncation; that boundary is covered directly through the production packing helper with synthetic oversized rows. These tests have not been run for this change. No capability is advertised.
